defect: external reset release timing is unspecified
rationale: The external reset directly releases a clocked state element, but the environment does not specify whether deassertion is synchronized or meets recovery and removal relative to clk; the design cannot establish safety or failure from RTL and constraints alone.

mutation.description: Preserved a direct external asynchronous reset with no release-timing contract.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the primitive to one resettable data register.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: External async reset released directly into the clock domain with no synchroniser and no constraint stating its release timing.
